nodes.label: Non-negotiables (RLS-first, guest-list privacy, reduced motion, transform/opacity-only animation, mobile-first, no CMS, dependency approval gate)
nodes.rationale: These constraints protect guest data privacy (RLS verified before writes; authenticated != admin; scoped admin reads), accessibility (prefers-reduced-motion disables all animation), performance (only transform/opacity animate, mobile-first for a mostly-phone audience), and scope control (no CMS/content editing, dependency approval required) for a one-developer project with a hard deadline.
